scope.geography: Bay Area first; Cleveland/Ohio second; nationwide third. No equally well-verified Ohio roles met the selection criteria today.
scope.selection_rule: Only exact official employer/ATS requisitions with visible application form as of 2026-10-23; late-2026 PhD completion not treated as an automatic exclusion; publicly describable fit only.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Functional Genomics
jobs.work_arrangement: On-site; application asks about five days per week
jobs.posting_status: Exact official Greenhouse requisition has a live Apply form as of check.
jobs.job_description: Develop and scale organoid models for CRISPR-based functional genomics and screening, integrating quantitative data with AI/ML discovery teams.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD with 0–4 years of subsequent experience
Hands-on patient-derived or other organoid development and characterization
jobs.why_good_match: Very strong match to publicly describable organoid, tissue engineering and quantitative assay skills; Bay Area priority.
likely_gaps: Direct CRISPR delivery and pooled screening in organoids may require upskilling
PhD must be complete before role start; confirm 2027 timing
jobs.tailor: Foreground organoid culture, human tissue model development, reproducible assay design and interdisciplinary data analysis; be specific about CRISPR experience level.
jobs.immediate_action: Submit CV through official Greenhouse form; clarify expected PhD completion and feasible start date.

jobs.title: Scientist II, High Throughput Biology
jobs.posting_status: Exact official Greenhouse requisition shows Apply form; listing explicitly welcomes recent PhD graduates with level adjustment.
jobs.job_description: Design cell-based and molecular assays, scale high-throughput functional screening and automation, and analyze sequencing-based readouts.
key_must_have_requirements: Relevant PhD; recent graduates explicitly considered
jobs.why_good_match: Quantitative cell models, assay development, experimental workflows and transcriptomic analysis are transferable to high-throughput discovery.
likely_gaps: Pooled screening, flow cytometry and display-library workflows
jobs.tailor: Frame expertise as a reproducible platform-development track record; highlight assay validation and scRNA-seq analysis, without asserting unverified screening experience.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply via Greenhouse and ask recruiter about appropriate level for a late-2026 PhD completion.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist Single Cell Assay and Technology Development
jobs.posting_status: Exact official Greenhouse requisition shows Apply form; posting says title may be adjusted for strong applicants with fewer years.
jobs.job_description: Invent and optimize single-cell/NGS assay technologies, molecular readouts and scalable experimental workflows for drug discovery.
key_must_have_requirements: Demonstrated single-cell or NGS assay invention or major improvement
NGS library preparation, assay chemistry and quality control
Mammalian cell assays and R/Python analysis
jobs.why_good_match: Broad single-cell, cell-model and bioengineering methods overlap; technology-development focus aligns with an engineering research trajectory.
likely_gaps: Role asks for extensive hands-on NGS assay chemistry and single-cell technology invention
jobs.tailor: Lead with documented assay/platform inventions, reproducibility, quantitative data and technology-transfer experience; do not overstate sequencing wet-lab depth.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply only with a targeted assay-development CV and explicitly invite level adjustment.
